currency.basis: MBANK brand launched Feb 2023, legal rename registered 2025-01-30, licenses replaced 2025-02-05; mbank.kg live site (fetched 2026-10-03) uses the MBANK mark in its header and publishes it as the current brand kit.

identity.basis: Record 15649 'Кыргызстан Коммерциялык банкы' (fullTitle 'Коммерческий банк Кыргызстан (MBANK)', url cbk.kg) is the same legal entity that now operates as MBANK (mbank.kg); the catalog metadata itself names MBANK. Fetched mark matches the MBANK brand published on the bank's own site.

assessment.independenceRationale: Official brand page assets are corroborated by the bank's rebrand announcements and an independent KSE listing document; the icon-only vector and the ICO raster come from different site files and agree.

variant.basis: Icon-only rounded-square app-mark variant observed as the site favicon (SVG vector and 64px ICO raster agree); the wordmark lockup exists separately and is deliberately not used because accompanying lettering is not catalog-suitable. Backing is the source's own branded gradient rounded square with internal transparency outside it.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Both 'M' strokes with rounded terminals preserved; yellow (#FABF00) and white fills and the teal-green gradient backing match the source; rounded-square contour and outside transparency intact; only the drop shadow is absent.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Rounded square fills the cell with even margins; emblem centered at its observed position; recognizable at 24/32/48 px on both themes; no clipping, distortion or stretching.
candidate.rationale: Supported rebrand: OAO 'Коммерческий банк Кыргызстан' launched the MBANK brand (Feb 2023) and was legally renamed (registered 2025-01-30); the accepted icon still shows the older abstract mark. The current official icon-only MBANK mark replaces it.
candidate.role: Official icon-only app/site mark of MBANK, served by mbank.kg as its favicon SVG alongside the brand kit on the official logo page.
transforms: Presentation adaptation: removed the source's Gaussian drop-shadow filter (<filter> with feFlood/feColorMatrix/feGaussianBlur) because the pinned Svg2Vector converter rejects filter elements; emblem paths, gradient backing and geometry unchanged.

Optimization: SVGO 4.1.0 (config sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e), working-no-shadow 1334 bytes -> selected final 26fe18ef88d279a5c92e2dd4aa5e6e1d8943084a926f694cd85ffd62ffd553b1 (1233 bytes); rsvg render pixel-identical between working-no-shadow and optimized.
candidate.variant: Yellow and white 'M' stroke pair on the source's own rounded-square teal-to-green gradient backing; transparency outside the rounded square. Wordmark lockup deliberately not used.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Base is the older abstract yellow-chevron/teal-circle mark; final is the current MBANK app mark with its gradient rounded-square backing. The difference is the documented 2023-2025 rebrand, not serialization.

proposals.reason: Bank rebranded from Коммерческий банк Кыргызстан to MBANK: brand launched Feb 2023 (mbank.kg), re-registered as OAO 'Мбанк' 2025-01-30, licenses replaced 2025-02-05. The existing icon shows the older abstract yellow-chevron/teal mark; the bank's current official identity is the MBANK mark, whose icon-only variant (yellow+white 'M' strokes on a teal-to-green gradient rounded square) is served by the bank's own site as an original vector favicon SVG.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Official icon-only original vector of the current MBANK mark from the bank's own site (fetched from the brand page context https://mbank.kg/ru/guide_logo): self-contained 56x56 SVG, two 'M' stroke paths plus rounded-square teal-green gradient backing; no embedded raster, no tracing. Replaces the pre-rebrand abstract mark with the current evidenced design.

sources.independenceGroup: mbank.kg official brand page and its own assets
sources.observation: Official brand/logo page of mbank.kg (fetched 2026-10-03) publishes the MBANK logo kit: full/white/black SVG wordmark lockups, EPS variants, brand-guideline ZIP/PDF. The site's favicon SVG (favicon2.c2389d75.svg, fetched 2026-10-03) is a self-contained 56x56 original vector of the icon-only mark: yellow and white 'M' strokes on a rounded-square teal-to-green gradient backing, matching the 64px ICO favicon raster inspected as research evidence.
Bank's own news page documents the rebrand of OAO 'Коммерческий банк Кыргызстан' to the MBANK brand; corroborated by 2025 registration/license news items found via search.
Kyrgyz Stock Exchange listing audit document (June 2025) refers to the renamed bank, independently corroborating the legal renaming timeline found in the bank's announcements.
